name: Child's Pose Side Reach

instructions.description: Start on your hands and knees, then slowly sit your hips back toward your heels.
Extend both arms forward with your palms on the floor. Walk your hands slowly to one side until you feel a gentle stretch along the opposite side of your torso.
Take slow, deep breaths and focus on expanding the side of your rib cage with each inhale. Keep your hips relaxed and close to your heels.
Walk your hands back to the center and return to the starting position. Repeat the stretch on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record a comfortable breathing rate without prescribing a universal norm.

variations.variationDescription: Child's Pose Side Reach — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Use cushions or a chair-supported version if floor kneeling is unsuitable.
